newsitem.title: USA: New York tycoon Trump and wife to separate.
newsitem.headline: New York tycoon Trump and wife to separate.

text.p: Real estate tycoon Donald Trump and his wife Marla Maples said on Friday they were separating after more than three years of marriage.
Trump, 50, whose assets include several Atlantic City casinos, the Plaza Hotel in Manhattan and other prime buildings, has an estimated worth of $2.5 billion.
"After a long relationship and a 3-1/2 year marriage, we have decided to separate, as friends," the couple said in a statement.

The New York Post reported the break-up Friday, quoting sources close to the couple as saying the relationship had not been the same since April 1996 when Maples was seen on a secluded beach with her bodyguard in the early hours of the morning. Trump said at the time that the bodyguard was keeping watch while Maples went to relieve herself.

The newspaper reported that the 33-year-old Maples' pre-nuptial agreement was estimated at between $1 million and $5 million and would have doubled in eight months when they entered the fifth year of marriage. The couple was married in December 1993. They have a 4-year-old daughter, Tiffany.

Trump's previous marriage ended in 1990 after his affair with Maples, a former Georgia beauty contestant. Ivana Trump came away with more than $50 million in a bitter divorce from the billionaire in 1992.
